scripts.lib: bun run --cwd packages/usa-club-rugby-data build && bun run --cwd packages/usa-club-rugby-components build
scripts.snapshot: bun run lib && node packages/usa-club-rugby-data/dist/cli.js snapshot
scripts.verify: bun run lib && node packages/usa-club-rugby-data/dist/cli.js verify
scripts.typecheck: bun run lib && tsc --noEmit && bun run --cwd packages/usa-club-rugby-data typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/usa-club-rugby-components typecheck
scripts.test: bun run lib && bun run --cwd packages/usa-club-rugby-data test && bun test ./src ./packages/usa-club-rugby-components/src ./playwright
